parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description:
Accelerator type. Valid values:

- CPU: CPU-only computing without accelerators.

- GPU: GPU-accelerated computing.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Page number of the result list. Default: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of instance types per page.
